transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I keep starting things—like the sanitation steps, the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork—and I somehow just... leave out the last parts. It's really frustrating because I know my job depends on finishing them correctly, but I just keep missing the end of them.
When you leave out the last part of a task, is it because you get stuck checking it over and over?

No, it's not that. I don't really get stuck checking things over and over. It's more like... I just sort of lose focus. My mind just moves on to the next thing before the first task is actually finished, so I just walk away or stop without realizing there was still a step left to do.
Did you have the same kind of trouble finishing tasks when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. Actually, my mom still has some of my elementary school report cards from around fourth grade. They usually said I was bright, but that I needed constant reminders to finish my classwork and actually turn in my homework. I remember understanding the lessons fine, but I would just miss big chunks of the instructions unless the teacher stayed right next to me.
Do you have the same trouble finishing things in other parts of your life, like at home?
I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it being an issue at home, to be honest. It really just seems to be at work where I'm having all this trouble.
Outside of work, do you also tend to leave tasks unfinished?
Like I just said, I haven't really noticed it being a problem at home. It really just seems to be an issue at work. Outside of my job, I don't think I leave things unfinished like that.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?
No, not really. I don't feel anxious or on edge. I mean, I get a little frustrated with myself when I mess up at work, but I wouldn't say I feel anxious in general.
Do you often act or speak before thinking?

No, I don't think so. I don't really have a problem with blurting things out or jumping into things. I usually just keep my head down and do my work, so... no, I wouldn't say I act or speak before thinking.
Do you often forget important information, like appointments or conversations?

Not really. I don't have much trouble remembering things like that. I always know when my shifts are at the plant, and I make it to my appointments fine. I usually remember what people tell me, too, so... no, I don't think I have a problem with forgetting important information.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No, not really. I haven't been feeling depressed or anything like that. I mean, I get pretty tired after a long shift, but my mood is generally fine. So, no, I wouldn't say I feel down.
Did these concentration problems start only after a head injury or other medical problem affecting your brain?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or medical issues with my brain. The concentration problems have just always been there, really. So, no, it didn't start after anything like that.
